pitfalls.title: stale_lockfile_drift
pitfalls.description: Package manifest changes can drift from tracked lockfiles and break frozen-lockfile or deployment paths.
pitfalls.symptom_pattern: Install or deploy failures complaining that lockfiles are out of date with package manifests.
pitfalls.prevention_rule: Treat tracked lockfiles as source truth and resynchronize every affected workspace when dependency changes land.
pitfalls.detection_hint: Run continuity and lockfile-aware verification after dependency edits.

pitfalls.title: diagnostics_serialization_crash
pitfalls.description: Diagnostics formatting can crash the error handler if stringify results are treated as guaranteed strings.
pitfalls.symptom_pattern: Routes return empty or opaque 500 responses because the logging path threw while handling the original error.
pitfalls.prevention_rule: Server error-handling and diagnostics serialization must never throw.
pitfalls.detection_hint: Review error-path logging changes for unsafe stringify or string-method calls.

pitfalls.title: request_json_parse_falls_into_500
pitfalls.description: Malformed request bodies can throw before validation and fall through to generic 500 handling.
pitfalls.symptom_pattern: Bad client payloads look like server failures instead of explicit malformed-body 400s.
pitfalls.prevention_rule: Wrap request.json() in try/catch before schema validation in POST routes.
pitfalls.detection_hint: Search POST routes for inline safeParse(await request.json()) patterns.

pitfalls.title: consumed_response_stream_fallback
pitfalls.description: Calling response.json() before response.text() consumes the stream and hides fallback diagnostics.
pitfalls.symptom_pattern: Fallback parse branches receive empty text after the first parse attempt.
pitfalls.prevention_rule: Read response.text() first, then parse JSON from the captured text if needed.
pitfalls.detection_hint: Search for response.json() fallback patterns followed by response.text().

pitfalls.title: generated_artifact_cleanup_miss
pitfalls.description: Verification runs can leave build, audit, or emulator outputs behind and pollute continuity signoff.
pitfalls.symptom_pattern: Continuity fails or dirty-tree noise appears after otherwise passing verification.
pitfalls.prevention_rule: Clean generated artifacts before final signoff.
pitfalls.detection_hint: Run the generated-artifact check before completion.

pitfalls.title: sidecar_truth_confusion
pitfalls.description: Fallback, RTDB, or Data Connect sidecars can be mistaken for canonical serving truth when they are not current in-repo readers.
pitfalls.symptom_pattern: Sidecar/export layers are treated as if they are the main product-serving analytics source.
pitfalls.prevention_rule: Do not represent fallback or derived data as stronger truth than source truth.
pitfalls.detection_hint: Check whether the candidate storage layer has a verified in-repo reader before treating it as canonical.

pitfalls.title: route_runtime_stale_vs_unseen_confusion
pitfalls.description: Stale route samples and never-observed route samples have different meanings and should not be collapsed together.
pitfalls.symptom_pattern: Debug summaries overstate failures because stale, unseen, and healthy states are not separated.
pitfalls.prevention_rule: Use shared route-runtime freshness and coverage helpers.
pitfalls.detection_hint: Check route-runtime summaries for ad hoc last-result logic instead of shared helpers.

pitfalls.title: unchecked_response_ok_ui_hydration
pitfalls.description: Client module hydration that parses bodies without response.ok guards can downgrade route failures into misleading empty states.
pitfalls.symptom_pattern: UI renders as empty or stale even though the backing route failed.
pitfalls.prevention_rule: Parse route responses through a helper that validates response.ok before hydrating UI state.
pitfalls.detection_hint: Search for response.json() before a response.ok branch in client fetch flows.

pitfalls.title: silent_ui_fallback_masking_failure
pitfalls.description: Fallback UI data should not hide the fact that a critical module failed to hydrate.
pitfalls.symptom_pattern: Users see partial content without any warning that a creator/admin module is degraded.
pitfalls.prevention_rule: Fallbacks must render explicit warning state and emit diagnostics.
pitfalls.detection_hint: Inspect async-heavy UI modules for fallback data with no warning shell.
